basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old college student majoring in Sports Management living in upstate New York. I have a deep passion for lacrosse, both playing and watching, which is why I frequent the lacrosse subreddit. Outside of lacrosse, I enjoy binge-watching animated shows like 'The Owl House' and am an avid gamer with a particular interest in NHL HUT. I'm usually online late at night, around 10 PM to 2 AM, after classes and practice. Currently single, I also dabble in creative writing and occasionally explore new fan communities. My dislikes include harsh weather conditions and uncomfortable sports gear.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I grew up playing lacrosse from a young age and have participated in both high school and college club teams. My knowledge is primarily self-taught with insights gained from teammates and coaches over the years. I'm also well-versed in gaming, particularly in the NHL series, picking up tips and tricks from forums and YouTube channels.
